text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from a day out together,
Yamanin Zephyr tells me she
wants to feel the
wind, so we climb to
the top of a hill.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Zephyr and her trainer!
Heeey!
Over here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a pleasant breeze. Did you
two
come to feel the wind too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heya. Nahhh, we just wanted a change
of pace.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo here got a pretty rough
score on her
quiz the other day, so.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature's helping me study! Right now
we're just
taking a break!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Are you on a walk?
Wanna
hang out with us?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're like a teacup typhoon, my
energetic
and spiky little friend.
choice_data_list: I don't think we have enough time ...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Spiky"?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, break's over. Time to get back to
studying,
Spiky Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Spiky Turbo"?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Your makeup quiz is tomorrow, so we
need to
review everything again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Consider us a passing wind with no
intention of
disrupting you. We'll be
over—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aww! I'm done studying! I wanna play!
C'mon, let's
play with Zephyr and her
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I could almost mistake you for Chubby
Cheeks
the way you hop and plead,
Spiky-Spike.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Chubby Cheeks? That's your name for sparrows, right? Sigh... I guess there's no way she's gonna be able to concentrate now, anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What would you like to play,
Spiky-Spike?
Tag? Shall we sing? Or do
something else
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not Spiky-Spike! I'm Twin Turbo! And
um...
uh... I dunno what to choose!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, take all the time you need to think
about it.
The wind is very calm at the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr normally marches to the
beat of
her own drum, but she seems to
be acting
differently around Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well this is sweet. She's treating Twin
Turbo like a
little forest critter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She speaks to Twin Turbo in the same
tone of voice she uses for small animals,
but Twin Turbo doesn't seem to mind—in
fact, she seems to be
enjoying it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I dunno... You like the wind, right? How
about we
fly a kite? Ah, wait, we don't
even have a kite!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, becoming the wind is quite
possible, but
becoming a kite is not. Do
you have any ideas,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having Yamanin Zephyr turn the
conversation to
me feels like a rare and
precious opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't let her down with my answer. If
they don't
have a kite, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't let her down with my answer. If
they don't
have a kite, then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You'll... be our kite?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer's awesome, Zephyr! I wanna
be a kite
too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, you can't just be a kite! C'mon, let's think before we speak here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I panicked and said something weird. I
hope
Yamanin Zephyr doesn't think I'm
unreliable now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If I become a sunset storm, I just
might be
able to hoist you up into the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, your idea wasn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr chuckles to herself. Only
someone striving to be the wind
would say
something like that. The thing
is, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if Yamanin Zephyr becomes the
wind, I
decide I'd rather keep my feet
safe on the
ground.
choice_data_list: Let's rule out floating it in the ...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that could work. But what if they
fly off
into town?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If we lost them, it'd be littering, and it
could be
dangerous if any end up on the
road.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the evening breeze, white turns
to
orange... Spiky-Spike's paper airplane
is flying
beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What? You already threw one?! Where is
it?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Over there!
It flew really fast 'cause I put
a turbo
jet on it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the paper airplane flies across the
dusk sky, I
notice it has lines of text
across it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh yeah! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You were supposed to correct your
mistakes on
that one and turn it back in!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It goes right, then left, flying on
and on. The wind simply cannot be
captured. I wonder if
the whispering
wind is having some fun of its own.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: This isn't a game anymore! Go and get it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ack! It's so high up! I can't reach it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature, Twin Turbo, and I chase
after the
airborne quiz paper in a panic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr, meanwhile, calmly
watches the
paper plane as it rides the
wind.
